summary: Auth.js v5 Node-runtime instance. Credentials provider with bcrypt compare, JWT session strategy (maxAge 8h), jwt/session callbacks that carry id and role. Documents why a Prisma database session strategy is rejected by Auth.js for Credentials-only providers.

Edge-safe Auth.js base config: no adapter, no providers, no Node imports. Exposes pages.signIn=/login and an authorized callback returning !!auth?.user. Consumed by middleware for a coarse session check.
THE authorization choke point. getCurrentUser() returns session.user from the JWT with zero database queries; requireRole() delegates to it and redirects to /unauthorized on failure. 25 importers.
Permission matrix. Permission union type, ROLE_PERMISSIONS per Role, can(role, permission), and named role-group constants used by Server Actions instead of inline literals. 27 importers.
loginAction (useActionState signature) and logoutAction. Returns {error} rather than throwing.
Centered-card layout for the (auth) route group. Performs NO session check — any route placed here is outside the dashboard redirect gate.

Edge middleware: IP-keyed fixed-window rate limiter (60s window; 60 general, 10 on /api/auth/*) wrapping NextAuth's coarse session check. Matcher excludes only login and static assets. NOTE: middleware.ts is deprecated in Next.js 16 in favour of proxy.ts (Node runtime).

getClientIp() reads x-forwarded-for / x-real-ip. Carries an extensive TRUST BOUNDARY warning: with no reverse proxy in front (the shipped docker-compose topology), this value is attacker-controlled on every request and the rate limiter provides no protection.
checkRateLimit fixed-window counter over a module-level Map, plus rateLimited() 429 response with Retry-After.
Prisma 7 client singleton using @prisma/adapter-pg, cached on globalThis in dev. Highest fan-in module in the codebase (28 importers).

17 models and enums. Role enum (5 values), Auth.js scaffolding (Account/Session/VerificationToken — unused under JWT strategy), CRM (Company/Site/Contact/Contract/Asset), service desk (Ticket/TicketComment), billing (TimeEntry/Invoice/InvoiceLineItem), QuickBooksConnection.

TimeEntry. ticket relation is onDelete: Cascade — deleting a Ticket destroys its time entries. invoiceLineItem is onDelete: SetNull, so the billed line item survives. This asymmetry is a billing-integrity hazard for any ticket-delete path.

8 timestamped migrations: init, add_crm_core, add_ticketing, add_time_tracking_billing, fix_time_entry_invoice_line_item_not_unique, add_reporting_indexes, add_reporting_indexes_followup, add_defense_in_depth_indexes.

The ONLY user-creation path in the tree — an upsert loop over the five roles with bcrypt-hashed passwords. Throws under NODE_ENV=production unless ALLOW_SEED_IN_PRODUCTION=true. E2E fixtures depend on these accounts.
Ticket Server Actions: createTicket, updateTicket, updateTicketStatus, assignTicket, deleteTicket. Gated by TICKET_MANAGE_ROLES / TICKET_ASSIGN_ROLES.

deleteTicket — ownership-scoped (technicians may only delete tickets assigned to them; dispatcher/admin unrestricted). Has ZERO call sites in src/. Its docstring names only the TicketComment cascade and omits the TimeEntry cascade.
Timer Server Actions: startTimer (per-user already-running guard), stopTimer, updateTimeEntry, deleteTimeEntry. Gated by TIME_ENTRY_MANAGE_ROLES.
Largest module in the codebase. generateInvoice (date range per company, applies contract billing rules), finalizeInvoice, pushInvoiceToQbo. Gated by INVOICE_MANAGE_ROLES.

QBO invoice line construction hardcodes ItemRef: { value: "1", name: lineItem.description } — every pushed line references QuickBooks item id 1. Accepted debt since Phase 4; needs a real item mapping.
createCompany, updateCompany, deleteCompany. Gated by CRM_MANAGE_ROLES.
createSite, updateSite, deleteSite — sites belong to a company.
createContact, updateContact, deleteContact.
createContract, updateContract, deleteContract. Contracts carry billing type and SLA targets consumed by sla.ts and billing.ts.
createAsset, updateAsset, deleteAsset — devices tied to a company and optionally a site.
addComment — appends a TicketComment. Also the mechanism the email poller and SLA sweep use to record breach flags.
disconnectQbo and setCompanyQboCustomerId. Gated by QBO_MANAGE_ROLES (admin only).
Pure billing rules, no Prisma. computeBlockHourCharge, computeFlatFeeCharge, computeHourlyBreakfixCharge, and the computeContractCharges dispatcher over BillingType.
Pure SLA logic. computeSlaDeadlines derives response/resolution deadlines from contract targets; getSlaStatus returns no_sla | on_track | approaching | breached | met.
computeElapsedMinutes and formatDuration — pure helpers shared by TimerControl and the time entry list.
All three reports plus date-range helpers. getTechnicianUtilization, getSlaCompliance, getClientProfitability, parseDateRangeBoundaries, isValidDateString, getCurrentMonthRange.
AES-256-GCM encrypt/decrypt over TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY. Added in Phase 6 to stop QuickBooks OAuth tokens being written to the database in plaintext.

QuickBooks Online OAuth and client. exchangeCodeForTokens, refreshAccessToken, getValidQboClient (refresh-on-expiry), buildAuthorizeUrl. Tokens round-trip through crypto.ts. Endpoint URLs were never verified against Intuit's live docs.
isNextRedirectError — required whenever redirect() is called inside a try/catch, because Next signals redirects by throwing. 10 importers.
cn() — clsx + tailwind-merge class combiner used by every shadcn component.
8 zod schemas: company, site, contact, contract, asset, ticket, time-entry, invoice. Each exports a schema plus an inferred Input type. Server Actions parse here rather than inline.
contractSchema is a zod discriminatedUnion over billingType — the most structurally interesting validator in the codebase. Changing BillingType requires editing this union.
Authenticated shell. Calls getCurrentUser() and redirects to /login when null; renders role-aware AppSidebar and UserMenu. This is where a mustChangePassword gate would belong.
Dashboard home with role-aware summary content.
Ticket detail — comments, assignment control, timer control, time entry list, SLA badge. The natural home for a delete control, which does not exist today.
Kanban board page — the primary dispatch surface.
Company detail with tabbed sub-views (sites, contacts, contracts, assets), each an async Server Component.

The only route under /admin. QBO connection status, connect/disconnect, and company->QBO customer mapping. Gates with getCurrentUser() + can(role,'qbo:manage') + manual redirects (:50-58) -- it predates the requireRole convention, so use it as a LAYOUT model only, not a gating model.
Three report pages — utilization, sla, profitability — each reading src/lib/reporting.ts and gated by REPORT_VIEW_ALL_ROLES for the cross-user views.
Invoice list and detail. Detail hosts InvoiceLineTable and PushToQboButton.
Re-exports NextAuth GET/POST handlers. The real credential-check surface; rate-limited by middleware at 10 req/60s.
Starts the QBO OAuth flow; sets the qbo_oauth_state cookie and redirects to Intuit.
QBO OAuth callback — validates state, exchanges the code, encrypts tokens via crypto.ts before persisting QuickBooksConnection.
Shared loading and error boundaries covering all 13 dashboard routes (error.tsx alongside).

Role-aware navigation. The admin:manage_users guard wraps a single <li> whose ternary renders ONE link labelled "Admin" pointing at /admin/quickbooks, plus a dead else-branch (its condition can never be false inside a block already gated on admin:manage_users). There is no Admin section and no link labelled "QuickBooks" -- adding a destination means restructuring the <li>.
@dnd-kit drag-and-drop board; drops call updateTicketStatus. Uses snap-x/lg:snap-none for the responsive breakpoint.
Start/stop timer widget driving startTimer and stopTimer.
Renders SLA status via theme tokens (bg-primary / bg-secondary / destructive). on_track and met share styling and are distinguished by label text.
Largest component. Ticket create/edit form plus the separate AssignmentControl, which calls assignTicket directly without navigation.
CRM forms and tabs. The *-tab.tsx files (sites, contacts, contracts, assets) are async Server Components; the *-form.tsx files are client forms. Shared CrmTabProps in tab-types.ts.
GenerateInvoiceForm, InvoiceLineTable, InvoiceStatusBadge, PushToQboButton.
DateRangeFilter, CompanyContractFilter, UtilizationTable, ProfitabilityTable, SlaComplianceSummary.
12 shadcn/ui primitives over radix-ui: avatar, badge, button, card, dropdown-menu, input, label, select, separator, table, tabs, textarea. Generated — avoid hand-editing.

Standalone worker run as its own Compose service. Microsoft Graph mailbox poll creating tickets from email, plus checkSlaBreaches() sweep. requireEnv() fails fast on AZURE_TENANT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_ID, AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET, MAILBOX_ADDRESS.
SLA_BREACH_MARKER = '[SLA BREACH]' — a greppable prefix on breach comments used as the re-notification guard. Changing the string orphans every already-flagged breach.
Shared Playwright fixtures — loginAs(role) and ROLE_CREDENTIALS for all five seeded roles. Every spec depends on the seeded accounts.
Ticket lifecycle E2E. Lines 228-255 hold two test.fixme cases for ownership-scoped delete, honestly skipped because no delete UI exists to drive.
End-to-end time-entry through invoice-generation flow.
SLA timer and badge E2E; uses an admin login because dispatcher cannot create the CRM contract the SLA-bearing ticket requires.
The only direct unit/regression coverage in the codebase, over reporting.ts date handling and aggregation.
fullyParallel: true with a webServer running `npm run dev` against the DEV database — there is no separate test database. Parallel specs share state.
Three services: app (publishes 3000:3000, no reverse proxy), email-poller, db (postgres:16-alpine, publishes ${DB_PORT:-5432}). postgres:postgres credentials appear in all three service definitions.

Scripts: dev, build, start, lint, db:migrate, db:migrate:deploy (runs scripts/post-migrate.sh), db:seed, email-poller, test:e2e. Next 16.3.3, React 19.2.8, Prisma 7.10, next-auth 5 beta, zod 4, Tailwind 4.
Empty NextConfig — no options set. Relevant because the Next 16 middleware→proxy migration renames config flags (skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize → skipProxyUrlNormalize); neither is set here.
Module augmentation adding id and role to Session.user and the JWT. Any change to what getCurrentUser() returns starts here.
